data.name: Kusumanjali
data.gender_notes: Kusumanjali is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Offering of fragrance to the Lord
data.long_meaning: Kusuma (fragrance) Anjali (offering): A name for the girl who offers the fragrance of devotion to the Lord. The name Kusumanjali carries the meaning “Offering of fragrance to the Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kusumanjali usually hope their child will grow to embody offering of fragrance to the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: An offering of devotion to the divine.
data.etymology: Kusumanjali belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Offering of fragrance to the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kusumanjali total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
